name: Bonus-first (offer-led order)
angle: A reader who comes for the bonuses and wants to know the terms behind each figure before registering.
intent_summary: Brand-review page about the Incaspin online casino for players from Poland, ordered around the offer: the casino in brief, the fact table, then the welcome package with its terms, weekly promotions, loyalty programme and the sportsbook offer, followed by registration, payments, games, providers, mobile play, licence and safety, responsible gambling, support, an FAQ about bonuses and payouts and a closing assessment. Page voice: businesslike and comparative, paragraphs of three to four sentences, sentences of about 18 words on average; every bonus figure is followed by the condition it depends on (context before the figure, consequence, contrast); calls to action only at the welcome package, the weekly cashback and the sportsbook offer. All brand facts come from the AffBulk knowledge base incaspin-new; nothing is claimed about the legal status of the casino in Poland.

blocks.heading: Questions About Bonuses and Payouts
blocks.summary: Five short answers about bonuses and payouts: promo code, game contribution to wagering, weekly cashback, Boomerang Points and withdrawal time.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of exactly five items, each a bold question followed by a short answer of 25-35 words, in this order: (1) is a promo code needed for the welcome bonus (credited automatically, no code needed, entering a code for a Welcome Package bonus makes the player ineligible for it; never mention INC2 or INC3); (2) which games count towards wagering (slots 100%, card games, roulette, poker and video poker 5%, live dealer games 0%); (3) does the casino pay cashback: the question contains the name Incaspin Casino (the one occurrence of "Incaspin casino"), the answer: Weekly Cashback of up to 25% of weekly net losses, the amount depends on player activity and loyalty status; (4) how are Boomerang Points earned: the question must contain the keyword "Inca Spin" in the form "konto Inca Spin" (exactly once in the block), the answer: through real-money slots activity, lifetime points set the rank, spendable points open reward chests; (5) how long does a withdrawal take (up to 72 hours of internal processing, then the payment provider's time; wording must differ from the withdrawals section). The brand name "Incaspin" goes into one answer, not into a question. These are the only questions on the page; the questions are the one place where question form is allowed.
